objectives.description: Diagnose the gate-8 intermittent-failure report (team-lead's finding that verify-deploy.sh gate 8 fails roughly 4/9 times post-redeploy, while direct run-all.sh invocations pass consistently)
objectives.note:
Ran two background sequential-loop scripts (8 planned + 6 planned invocations of `bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh --findings`) to reproduce. Stopped early per team-lead's instruction to checkpoint and stop (context-clearing imminent) after 7 completed invocations across both loops (5 + 2): all 7 measured 23/23 PASS, gate 8 included -- the flake was NOT reproduced in this dispatch's own sample. This is a small, inconclusive sample against team-lead's larger 9-run sample showing ~4 failures; it neither confirms nor refutes the flake, it only fails to reproduce it in fewer trials.

Leading hypothesis, NOT confirmed: gate 8 internally re-runs the SOURCE-STORE run-all.sh (verify-deploy.sh:399 always targets agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/run-all.sh, never the deployed copy, regardless of which tree verify-deploy.sh is checking). On this dispatch's very first standalone source-store run-all.sh invocation (before the team-lead message, unrelated to any loop), a real failure was observed: test-claude-refresh-matcher.sh's 'is_live_inhibitor_target: still excludes the SAME inhibitor after its target (pid N) was killed -- tautological check' assertion FAILed, then PASSed cleanly on an immediate rerun. This suite is NOT one of the 18 files this task touched and is NOT the Phase 5 write_holder() race recurring -- it is a pre-existing, self-documented, load-sensitive flake: the suite backgrounds a real `sleep 300 &` process, kills it, then polls up to 8s for `kill -0` to report it dead before asserting liveness semantics, and its own comment states this budget was 'widened once already ... observed to need more than 2s of headroom when run alongside ~25 concurrent others'. Under run-all.sh's ~37-suite full sequence (the same load context gate 8 creates), this budget can plausibly still be exceeded on a loaded system, producing an intermittent, load-correlated failure unrelated to task-lock.sh.

Alternative hypothesis considered and NOT supported by code review: a residual write_holder()/cmd_acquire race in task-lock.sh, of the same shape Phase 5 fixed. Re-reading cmd_acquire's mkdir-then-branch flow and write_holder's mkdir -p fix (both already deployed) shows every write_holder call site is now covered by the unconditional mkdir -p recreate -- the specific TOCTOU window Phase 5 diagnosed and fixed is structurally closed. No new race was identified in this dispatch's code review.

Not resolved. Recommended next step: a dedicated follow-up task to (a) run a larger, unattended sample (15-20x) of `verify-deploy.sh --findings`, capturing `FINDING gate8` lines and the raw run_all_output on every failure, specifically watching for test-claude-refresh-matcher.sh's assertion text vs. any task-lock.sh/holder.json text; (b) if test-claude-refresh-matcher.sh is confirmed as the cause, widen its poll budget further (e.g. 8s -> 16-20s) or decouple the liveness assertion from real-process timing entirely (e.g. an injectable/mockable liveness predicate) rather than repeatedly widening a load-sensitive timing budget.
